data: On average, does print media receive more attention for clickbait posts or non-clickbait posts?

The question asks whether print media receives more attention for clickbait posts or non-clickbait posts on average. From the caption, blue areas indicate that clickbait posts receive more attention than non-clickbait posts, while green areas indicate the opposite. In the top row of the figure, which represents print media, the blue line is consistently above the green line, indicating that clickbait posts receive more attention than non-clickbait posts on average. Therefore, the answer is that print media receives more attention for clickbait posts on average.
